mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS recipe_id, r.name, r.category_code, s.source_type, s.source_key, r.source_document_id, d.content_hash AS source_content_hash, r.servings, r.estimated_minutes, r.additional_content FROM recipe r JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id JOIN recipe_source_document d ON d.id = r.source_document_id AND d.source_id = s.id WHERE ORDER BY r.id

SELECT r.id AS recipe_id, ri.id AS recipe_ingredient_id, ri.ingredient_id, i.normalization_status, ri.raw_name, ri.raw_line, ri.amount_min, ri.amount_max, ri.unit_code, ri.unit_label, ri.optional, ri.sort_order FROM recipe r JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id JOIN recipe_ingredient ri ON ri.recipe_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = ri.ingredient_id WHERE ORDER BY r.id, ri.sort_order, ri.id

SELECT r.id AS recipe_id, st.id AS step_id, st.step_no, st.content FROM recipe r JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id JOIN recipe_step st ON st.recipe_id = r.id WHERE ORDER BY r.id, st.step_no, st.id

SELECT r.id AS recipe_id, ct.id AS tool_id, ct.canonical_name AS name, rt.optional FROM recipe r JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id JOIN recipe_tool rt ON rt.recipe_id = r.id JOIN cooking_tool ct ON ct.id = rt.tool_id WHERE ORDER BY r.id, ct.id
